schema.ifbench: equal mean of the three 32k IFBench prompt-level-loose accuracies
schema.macro: equal mean of MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFBench, and HumanEval
schema.realized_k: weighted across all recorded token-layer observations and four servers; includes warmup
schema.inferred_hidden_reasoning_tokens: full completion tokens minus Qwen-tokenized returned text
